scientific_integrity: The argument is a field-independent proof with independently constructed finite tests in several prime fields; finite tests are not treated as a proof for all finite fields.
scientific_limitations: Centralizers are computed in the radical, not the full unital algebra; truncation exponent three and equal arrow multiplicity on a linear quiver. Exhaustive historical priority and independent mathematical validation are not established.
title: Centralizer spectra and commuting pairs in truncated parallel-arrow chain algebras
